messages:
IncidentBot: [INC-2026-03-14] Incident resolved — latency spike affecting hosted API between 10:12-10:47 PDT. Paging stopped at 10:47. Root cause: faulty autoscaler rollout + CPU pressure on control-plane job. Postmortem to be scheduled.
Alice J: thanks. leaving notes here for followups. oncall handoff to Ben complete, Ben — can you confirm any lingering mitigations?
Ben (oncall): confirmed mitigation = rollback of autoscaler change + pinning control-plane to previous image. metrics look stable now. will keep watch for 2h.
Carlos SRE: I captured heap profiles and traces under /incidents/1923456789. main CPU hotpath was reconciliation loop. I'll upload perf diff in a sec.
Olivia PM: we need timeline + customer-facing status. Dana, can you prepare a customer brief for the affected accounts? I can join call with lead customers if needed.
Dana CS: on it. can you share list of impacted orgs? (I'm pulling from the incident report)
Alice J: impacted: 8 orgs with >1% error increase, 3 with request timeouts. sent CSV to Dana. Also note: we paused a noncritical background job during mitigation.
Dana CS: draft incoming — please review quickly
Dana CS: ```Hi <customer>,
We experienced a service degradation today from 10:12–10:47 PDT affecting inference latency. Root cause identified as an autoscaler rollout triggering elevated control-plane CPU usage. We have reverted the change and are monitoring. We will share a full RCA and timeline by EOD tomorrow. Apologies for the disruption and thank you for your patience.
Best,
Redwood Support
```
Olivia PM: looks good. add note about any data integrity/no-data-loss guarantees. also mention our next steps and expected ETA for RCA.
Dana CS: added paragraph about no data loss and next steps + link to status page. updated draft in thread.
Tim Eng: action items from ops side:
- A1: Carlos to run root-cause perf analysis and PR (ownership: Carlos SRE)
- A2: Rollback gate added to autoscaler rollout pipeline (ownership: Alice J)
- A3: Add additional control-plane CPU alert with runbook (ownership: Ben (oncall))
- A4: Publish customer RCA and timeline (ownership: Olivia PM / Dana CS)
Please add any missing items.
Carlos SRE: taking A1. I'll post perf graphs + PR link by 17:00 PT.
Alice J: taking A2. I'll block the rollout and update CI by EOD.
Ben (oncall): taking A3. I'll author the alert and runbook. ping me if you want a quick walkthrough.
Olivia PM: scheduling postmortem — propose TOMORROW 11:00 PT, 60m. Agenda: timeline, root cause, action items, risk/rollback controls, customer comm plan. Anyone object?
Tim Eng: works for me.
Alice J: ok for me.
Dana CS: works; I'll prepare customer-facing timeline to share during PM.
Carlos SRE: available.
Ben (oncall): available.
IncidentBot: Postmortem meeting created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/pm-1923456789
Olivia PM: after PM, we want to publish the RCA to affected customers and update status page. Dana — please draft status page snippet and I'll review.
Dana CS: draft status page:
```Status: Service degradation detected and mitigated
Impact: Increased latency for a subset of API requests between 10:12–10:47 PDT
Action Taken: Reverted autoscaler rollout, pinned control-plane image, monitoring in place
Next Steps: Detailed RCA and timeline to be published within 24 hours; improved rollout gating
```
Alice J: also recommend adding a short technical appendix for enterprise customers describing mitigation.
Dana CS: noted. Olivia — do we want to proactively offer 1:1 customer briefings to the 3 most impacted orgs?
Olivia PM: yes, offer 1:1s. I'll coordinate with sales. Dana, please flag the 3 orgs in the outreach list.
Dana CS: flagged in the CSV; will send invites after PM.
Tim Eng: tracking remediation: I'll open a tracking board with the 4 action items and owners, link in thread when ready.
Tim Eng: tracker: https://boards.redwood.com/board/INC-1923456789
Carlos SRE: uploaded perf graphs and PR: https://git.redwood.com/perf/PR-5042
Alice J: PR for rollout gate: https://git.redwood.com/infra/PR-8921
Ben (oncall): alert/runbook PR: https://git.redwood.com/infra/PR-8922
Olivia PM: great. we should also include a short apology + next steps in the customer email. Dana, send draft after meeting; I'll approve.
Dana CS: will do. tagging followups as checkboxes in the tracker.
Alice J: thanks everyone. i'll keep monitoring and will escalate if anything spikes. closing the loop here. :thumbsup:
Ben (oncall): :eyes: monitoring 2h window.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-03-14 marked resolved and moved to postmortem stage.
